en.purpose: To non-invasively estimate Left Atrial Pressure (LAP) using Doppler echocardiography parameters.
en.use:
Use to calculate LAP from transmitral E velocity and mitral annular e' velocity.

Formula:
LAP = 1.24 * (E / e') + 1.9
en.misuse: Do not use in patients with heavy mitral annular calcification, mitral valve prostheses, severe mitral stenosis, or severe mitral regurgitation without clinical adjustment.

other_details.references:
Gorcsan J 3rd, Snow FR, Paulsen W, Nixon JV. Noninvasive estimation of left atrial pressure in patients with congestive heart failure and mitral regurgitation by Doppler echocardiography. Am Heart J. 1991 Mar;121(3 Pt 1):858-63. doi: 10.1016/0002-8703(91)90199-r. PMID: 2000753.

Nishimura RA, Tajik AJ. Determination of left-sided pressure gradients by utilizing Doppler aortic and mitral regurgitant signals: validation by simultaneous dual catheter and Doppler studies. J Am Coll Cardiol. 1988 Feb;11(2):317-21. doi: 10.1016/0735-1097(88)90096-4. PMID: 3339169.

Ge Z, Zhang Y, Fan D, Zhang M, Duran CM. Simultaneous measurement of left atrial pressure by Doppler echocardiography and catheterization. Int J Cardiol. 1992 Nov;37(2):243-51. doi: 10.1016/0167-5273(92)90215-o. PMID: 1452383.
